name: qa_envfilter
title: OS-INSFX-FX1, the Env Filter effect module (modules/effects/envfilter, kind 2) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard (the sweep follows the track's own level, and the level is not above bypass), its tail ends, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image). Console only: the insert is NOT saved (S3), and the console has no insert parameter verb, so the mode, resonance and range sweeps are a hand check once the Mixer's INSERTS page and the parameter page exist (S4, S5). Needs modules/effects/envfilter.tmod on the card (the build's modules/envfilter.tmod, copied by the tester). Reset the unit first so that envfilter is the only effect module loaded (`diag bench insert` times the first loaded effect). Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX1, rows QA-GLB-205 to 208 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-206 is a host test). Put modules/effects/envfilter.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a track 1 that plays hits with gaps: drums, a pluck, a bass line). The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3). The default setting is a low-pass (Mode LP) with Cutoff 400 Hz, Range +4 octaves, Resonance 0, Attack 5 ms, Release 150 ms, Sens +12 dB, Mix 100 %: track 1 must sound dull between the hits and open up on each hit (an auto-wah on the way up, closing in the decay), and be no louder than the bypassed track (`ins bypass 1 1 on` and `off` to compare)

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-205: the packed module passes the loader on the unit
QA-GLB-205: loaded, version 1.0.0; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): read it against the hot size of the build
QA-GLB-205: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters
QA-GLB-205: the insert runs (phase on) and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the figure the spec estimates at 1.2 % [est] (about 3.2k cycles a block settled))
QA-GLB-205: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-205: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-205 and QA-GLB-208, by ear: track 1 is filtered by a low-pass that follows its own level (dull between the hits, bright on the hits and closing again after about a quarter of a second: no clicks, no zipper), and its LEVEL IS NOT ABOVE the bypassed track's (the check DRIVE failed at its defaults: compare with `ins bypass 1 1 on`, and look for a hotter or clipped stem); the other tracks are unchanged. Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the clean sound returns with no click

steps.note: QA-GLB-205: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-205: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect starts from silence: the follower starts at 0, so the filter starts closed: no thump

QA-GLB-208: a second and a half after the stop there is no `tail` word: the filter at the defaults (Q 0.7, a cutoff of 400 Hz or more) rings for a few milliseconds and the module returns 0 as soon as its states are under -120 dBFS
QA-GLB-208: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the filter bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-207: bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`), transport stopped, envfilter the only loaded effect: `insert_effect` is the settled render() of 64 frames at the defaults, `insert_effect_mod` the same with set_param on Cutoff, the first MOD target, every block (a sweep: the smoothing runs every control step, the worst case), `insert` the whole insert with the adapter. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the budget (docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 rows)

steps.say: QA-GLB-207: copy the four BENCH lines (min / avg / max) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 rows, and into the module's README; the cap of four instances stays or is lowered from them (spec section 6)
